user.title: Canadian Wildland Fire Information System
user.description: Adds CWFIS wildfire data using your Home location. Use Configure afterwards to change the settings.

abort.single_instance_allowed: CWFIS is already set up. Use Configure on the existing entry to change its settings.

data_description.radius: Agency-reported fires within this distance of a zone count as nearby and raise Fire alert events. Hotspots, perimeters and prescribed burns are also counted within this distance.
data_description.zones: Home is always watched. Add zones (cottage, family, trip) to get the same sensors for each.
data_description.smoke_radius: How far away a fire can be and still count as a smoke source for Fire upwind and Wildfire smoke.
data_description.wind_entity: A sensor reporting the direction the wind is coming FROM, in degrees. Enables Fire upwind.
data_description.pm25_entity: An air-quality PM2.5 sensor (e.g. AirNow or PurpleAir). Enables Wildfire smoke.
data_description.pm25_threshold: PM2.5 at or above this counts as smoky. 35 µg/m³ is the US EPA 24-hour standard.
data_description.provinces: Adds Active fires and Area burned sensors for each agency picked. Every agency is always listed in the national sensors' attributes.
data_description.map_fires: Which fires get a map marker (geo_location.cwfis_* entity).
data_description.map_images: Canada-wide maps rendered by CWFIS, one image entity each. Works alongside the markers; show them with a Picture entity card.
